title: Warranty Coverage Sealed Unit Charge by Factory Build Class
content:
**Price list.** For a prorated sealed glass replacement under Warranty Coverage, the glass build charge per sealed unit follows the build class in which the factory built the units, as recorded on the Factory Production Orders record of the order that built them:

| Build class of the sealed units | Glass build charge per sealed unit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Impact-Rated Build | 480.00 (impact sealed-unit charge) |
| Specialty Glass Build | 395.00 (specialty sealed-unit charge) |
| Specialty Shape Build | 395.00 (specialty sealed-unit charge) |
| any other build class | no build-class charge under this list |

In clause form: sealed units built by the factory as an Impact-Rated Build take the impact sealed-unit charge; units built as a Specialty Glass Build or a Specialty Shape Build take the specialty sealed-unit charge; units of any other build class take no build-class charge under this list.

## Points of judgement

- The order is the Factory Production Orders record for the contract the Warranty Coverage registration covers.
- Architectural Wood Build, Custom Size Build and Custom Color Build are not on this list.
